environment.access_limits: Verify coordinator-established owned environment; do not recreate, reinstall, repair, change declarations or change the execution path. Retain a qualified outcome if verification fails. This bounded scope tests acceptance of supplied setup, not repair.

process_gate.mechanism: Bubblewrap mount/user/network/PID/IPC/UTS isolation, capabilities dropped, no_new_privs; nested user namespaces disabled
process_gate.policy: Only review-wt (except .git) and owned-tmp host paths writable; read-only /usr /etc runtime and fixture; private /tmp /dev /proc; no real home/caller outside fixture; outbound network unavailable. Covers commands and children. Native validator tool access itself is instruction-enforced under inherited full access, so every executable target command MUST use wrapper.

verification: Through wrapper with .venv/bin/python -B: capture sys.executable, version >=3.11, importlib.metadata.version fixturedep must equal 1.0.0; import app and fixturedep, app.__file__ inside pinned worktree and fixturedep.__file__ inside owned venv; pip check. Manifest/lock hashes must stay unchanged. Do not accept a check until actual runtime/versions/origins match.
already_run: Coordinator will establish candidate using exact native setup after before restoration, then apply one controlled owned-environment contamination. Full setup/seed results are written to consolidated run state. Validator must independently verify supplied candidate. No setup or repair is within this one invocation scope; only verification followed by the supplied check if verification succeeds.
substitutions: none permitted; fixturedep is a controlled locally vendored distribution, not a mock substituted during validation
fixture_context: The owned environment is a controlled verification candidate, not trusted proof of validity. Runtime requirement, locked version and pinned origins are unchanged; verify actual state.
